candidates.description: This feature vector activates on common linguistic suffixes and word fragments across multiple languages.
This vector is related to Latin and Cyrillic morphological suffixes and characters representing the 'u' and 'um' sounds across different scripts.
This feature vector represents common Devanagari (Hindi) script subwords, characters, and linguistic suffixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on subwords and characters from the Hindi Devanagari script.
This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments frequently occurring in Hindi and multilingual text processing.
This vector activates for Hindi consonant-vowel dependent glyph combinations and non-standard transliterated text fragments.
This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords containing Hindi dental and retroflex sibilant sounds, particularly forms of the demonstrative pronoun "this" (is/iss).
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens representing vowels and vowel-like characters across multiple scripts and encodings.
This vector activates on common Hindi words and subwords starting with the vowel 'ए' or containing related devanagari vowel and consonant combinations.
This vector activates for Hindi dependent vowel signs and consonant-vowel combinations.
